reviews.title: Reliable Product and Customer Service
reviews.comment:
I just wanted to leave a review on how great this group / seller is. I did have an issue but they made sure it was fully resolved.
Drive great and working, good communication, kind and thoughtful group.
reviews.author: Gkjr1

reviews.title: This may just be the right size.
reviews.comment: What is the right size of a hard disk today?  2TB? Too small. 20TB and above?  Nice for archival storage, but it will take you days to populate.  So 16 TB is just right.  This Seagate Disc is solid with no defects.  Good price and delivered on time.
reviews.author: Philip Miller

reviews.title: Seems fine, but no SMART data
reviews.comment:
So far the drive seems fine, although a bit noisier than other large drives like this. Read/Write speeds are about 280/260MBs.
My biggest gripe is the reseller goHardDrive erased all the SMART data, so I have no idea how long this drive has been hammered on for. I HIGHLY doubt this is a new drive.
I will try to update if this drive fails at some point.
reviews.author: Andrew

reviews.title: Renewed test continues after a week
reviews.comment: Four units, all renewed.  First week was intermittent use tests (computer was up-and-down with office hours), and limited 4-8tb COPY processes, all at 180-220mbs - good speeds for an old drive's USB to these new SATA drives.  For the last two days, they are running 28/8 - 28 hours a day, 8 days a week.  This will be their semi-normal life from here on.  I have ZERO faith in Seagate (much preferring HGST, pre-WD but since those days are dead 'n gone... well...) so these will be on constant watch/constant backup service.  We will get many more although the price increase over other drives means these are not a good value.
reviews.author: EMW
